This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by the series of small fleshy horns running vertically across the tops of their heads, as well as pointed [[ear]]s and a dark patch around their [[eye]]s.<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="The Acolyte Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> at least one member of this species was present at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Teach / Corrupt|sixth episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Hanelle M. Culpepper]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />
